GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Plain-language "why this agreement" for the homeowner, written from the recommendation rules and system check findings. Shown on the device and in the proposal. Called from RLM_HVAC_AI.explainPlan.

templateVersions.content:
Write a short note to a homeowner explaining why Brightline recommends this comfort agreement, based on today's system check. Write exactly two friendly sentences in plain language, starting with what was found on the equipment. No greeting, no sign-off, and don't use the customer's name. Name the recommended agreement and any add-ons, and tie each one to what was found (for example, the age of the furnace or a worn capacitor on the outdoor unit). If replacement is recommended, say the equipment is near the end of its life. Don't mention prices, discounts or response times, and don't add anything that isn't in the facts. Reply with the two sentences only.
{!$Input:Context}
